saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
A woman, maybe 60s is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 74/100)
Brunhilde and Landon lingered over the fire together.
Daniela and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
Tesfaye and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
Brian and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
Jorge and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the person in their 60s, with calloused knuckles Food Preservation.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the person in their 60s, with calloused knuckles let a place-name slip — somewhere that isn't Denver — then covered it with "Denver" so fast the cover was louder than the slip.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles).
👀 the man in his 20s, the glazier starts a story with "back when I was a glazier..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 20s).
Landon Hayes reads the sky: rain tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Sigrid," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Sigrid." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Sigrid).
"Grace," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Grace." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Grace).
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Tesfaye," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Tesfaye." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Tesfaye).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s is craving 2 Blackberries. "I'll trade you something good."
A person, maybe 40s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

🌿 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (16 logs now.)
A person, maybe 40s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
